prerequisites: Upload a validated real raw-count matrix to inputs/counts.rds; verify the requested gene is present. Small parameters below are a computational acceptance profile, not publication settings.

expected.run: local run_id; remote_key=job_id; status uses r.get.sc.tenifold.run; final manifest lists result tables

failure.condition: target absent, non-integer counts or unavailable runtime
failure.recovery: validate input and runtime before a new request; never describe normalized data as raw counts
